arguments.summary: A Golden Ticket attack was confirmed through detection of DCSync activity (Event ID 4662) originating from source IP 10.0.5.14 targeting domain controller 10.0.1.10. The attacker likely extracted the krbtgt hash, enabling forgery of Kerberos tickets with full domain privileges. Despite a containment directive for domain-wide credential revocation, execution failed as the required tool (T8_iam_pam) was not available or supported. Post-incident analysis confirmed lateral movement and C2 activity from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), which served as the initial access vector. No malicious artifacts were found on the domain controller itself, but the compromise of the krbtgt account renders all Kerberos tickets untrustworthy.
